label: Welcome
text: Thank you for reaching out to the Mental Health Support Line. My name is ___ and I am a specialist here. What would you like to talk about today?

label: Validation
text: That sounds really hard. It makes sense that you are feeling this way, and I am glad you reached out.

label: Asking about suicide
text: Sometimes when people feel the way you are describing, they think about suicide. Are you having thoughts of suicide?

label: Grounding exercise
text: Let's try something together. Can you name five things you can see around you right now?

label: Follow-up offer
text: Would it help if we called you back in a few days to see how you are doing?

label: Closing
text: Thank you for talking with me today. Remember you can reach us again anytime.
